title: 秒針の地下室、僕らのラストレップ
author: 一ノ瀬 楓

en.title: The Basement of the Second Hand, Our Last Rep
en.premise: Unable to keep up with the track team's practices and having lost sight of why he runs, I find an old notebook in the "underground library" hidden beneath the old school building. It was a record filled with a passion for running—like a "testament" left behind by a legendary runner who passed away suddenly a few years ago. Amidst a daily life driven by a constant stream of social media notifications, I use those words as a guide and begin to run at my own pace.

zh.title: 秒针的地下室，我们的末次迈进
zh.premise: 我跟不上田径部的训练，迷失了奔跑的意义，却在旧校舍地下的“地下图书馆”里发现了一本旧笔记本。那是几年前突然离世的传说中跑者留下的记录，字里行间充满了对奔跑的热情，宛如一份“遗言”。在被社交软件的通知声催促着的日常中，我以那些话语为路标，迈开只属于自己的步伐，再次奔跑起来。
